LESSON: USE OF TOILET HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Use of toilet Hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Use of toilet Hygiene
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is toilet, latrine and urinal in their locality, why they need to use the toilet etiquette?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Use of toilet Hygiene
2. give Kenyan examples of Use of toilet Hygiene
3. practise a safe skill for Use of toilet Hygiene

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Use of toilet Hygiene

Teach
• Observe Use of toilet Hygiene in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Use of toilet Hygiene (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Use of toilet Hygiene.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Use of toilet Hygiene.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Use of toilet Hygiene.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Use of toilet Hygiene.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Use of toilet Hygiene: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is toilet, latrine and urinal in their locality, why they need to use the toilet etiquette?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Use of toilet Hygiene with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
